stories.title: D11 First Day Is Here — All K-12 Students Start Today

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: D11's first day is here. All K–12 students start today, Aug 12. K–8 students get free Edukit supply kits on arrival. D20 starts Aug 17–18. D49 started Aug 3–4. 🎒 #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: D11 day one is almost done. Tonight: pack the bag for tomorrow, set that alarm, and ask one specific question about their day — not "how was school?" but something they can actually answer. You've got this. 🎒 #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: It's D11's First Day — Here's What K-12 Students and Parents Need to Know Today

stories.title: CPSC Warns Parents: Multiple Infant Walker and Swing Recalls This Month

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: CPSC: 3 infant walker brands recalled — Wnttmt/WURUI.BABY, Uuoeebb, WonderStone. Fall/entrapment risk. Plus: Bimuva swings — stop use now, suffocation risk. Full list at cpsc.gov. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: COS parents: check your Amazon/Walmart baby walker or swing orders. CPSC recalled Wnttmt, Uuoeebb, WonderStone walkers and warned against Bimuva swings this month. Full list: cpsc.gov. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: Stop Use Now: CPSC Recalls Multiple Infant Walkers and Warns Against Baby Swing in August 2026

stories.title: AAP Says All Kids 6 Months+ Should Get the Flu Shot — New 2026-27 Guidance

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: AAP just released its 2026–27 flu vaccine guidance: all kids 6 months and older should get a flu shot, ideally by end of October. Last season: 190 children died from flu. 85% were not vaccinated. Schedule it now. 💉 #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
